verification.notes: Read the live Esade Scholarship Program page and the Scholarship Program and Financial Aid overview page. Confirmed the 50%-85% MSc and MBA Talent Scholarship range, the 60%-100% Degree range, the Lodging/Living/Exchange/SUD complements, the Talent Attraction Committee's role, and the published programme facts: 5M EUR dedicated, 295 recipients, 84% of recipients' tuition covered, 8.4% of undergraduates funded, with 87% of funding from companies and foundations and 13% from alumni and the Esade community.

applicant_utility.summary: Esade's MSc and MBA Talent Scholarships sit in the 50-85% of tuition band, so expect a substantial discount rather than a free degree, and expect the decision to rest on two things at once: a genuinely strong academic record and a documented case of financial need. The Talent Attraction Committee reviews applications itself, and Esade publishes no call calendar, so the only reliable route is to apply to the MBA or MSc and raise funding with the admissions team rather than hunt for a posted closing date. If you live outside Barcelona province, the Lodging and Living Grants are the pieces most applicants overlook, and they are the ones that actually cover room, board and transport.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Academically strong MBA or MSc applicants whose family finances would otherwise make an Esade place unrealistic, and who can evidence need rather than merely assert it.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure admission to an official Esade MBA or MSc programme first - the Talent Scholarship is assessed against that application
Assemble evidence of financial need in the same terms Esade uses: household income, dependents and existing obligations
Check whether you qualify for the Lodging Grant as well, since it applies only to students living outside Barcelona province
If you are heading for an exchange term or an Esade SUD solidarity internship, flag it early - both have their own scholarship extensions
Ask Esade admissions directly for the current call dates, because none are published on the scholarship pages
Compare the Income-Share Agreement and Financial Aid routes on the same site before committing to a single funding plan
common_rejection_risks: A strong transcript with no evidence of financial need - both halves must be present
Applying to a programme that is not an official Esade MBA or MSc, which takes you outside the Talent Scholarship's scope
Waiting for a published call date that Esade does not post
Assuming the Lodging or Living Grant comes automatically with the tuition scholarship; they are separate complements with their own tests
Overlooking that donor-specific Degree Talent Scholarships can restrict you to a named programme or student profile
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The uncovered 15-50% of tuition, plus any living costs not met by the Lodging or Living Grants. Esade does not publish a travel allowance under this programme.
document_audit: The Scholarship Program page does not list the documents for a call, so confirm the exact pack with the Talent Attraction Committee rather than guessing
Financial-need evidence must match whatever the legally established criteria of the applicable call require, so do not assume last year's pack still applies
If a donor-specific award is in play, check the donor's programme restriction before you commit to a campus or intake
alerts: No dates are published anywhere on the Esade scholarship pages, so treat enquiries to the admissions or Talent Attraction team as part of the process rather than an optional extra
The Living Grant is aimed at transportation and general expenses, not tuition - do not budget it against fees
Exchange and SUD scholarships are extensions of the Talent Scholarship, so they presuppose that you already hold one
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to the official Esade MBA or MSc programme, then be reviewed by the Talent Attraction Committee, which confirms that candidates meet the established requirements of the applicable call.
